apps.name: StarLedger
apps.shortDescription: Sell Telegram Stars, convert NFTs to TON
apps.description: Sell Telegram Stars and convert NFTs into TON cryptocurrency with zero fees and instant payouts. No signup or account required, with payouts processed automatically to any TON-compatible wallet.

apps.name: StarNinja
apps.shortDescription: Buy Telegram Stars & Premium with crypto
apps.description: Buy Telegram Stars and Telegram Premium with crypto. Pays in TON, BTC, ETH, USDT, or 100+ other coins, delivered through Fragment in under a minute. Up to 45% cheaper than App Store pricing.

apps.name: Sora
apps.description: Crypto price and portfolio bot for Telegram. Type a ticker in any chat for instant prices, convert between coins, track a watchlist, pin a live ticker to a group, or run a private portfolio. Inline mode works in any chat.

apps.name: StarNinja Earn
apps.shortDescription: Earn free Telegram Stars by completing tasks
apps.description: Earn free Telegram Stars by completing tasks like joining channels and starting bots. No investment, just tasks. Refer friends for more rewards, and withdraw Stars directly to your Telegram account.

apps.name: AdEasly TON
apps.shortDescription: Earn TON by completing simple tasks
apps.description: Earn TON cryptocurrency by completing simple tasks: browse websites, join Telegram channels, start bots. Free to join with instant payouts to your TON wallet.

apps.name: AdEasly LTC
apps.shortDescription: Earn Litecoin by completing simple tasks
apps.description: Earn Litecoin by completing simple tasks: browse websites, join Telegram channels, start bots. Free to join with instant payouts to your LTC wallet. Same platform as AdEasly TON, paid in Litecoin.

apps.name: Group Game
apps.shortDescription: Word Chain & Quiz Bomb for groups
apps.description: Add it to a group and play Word Chain and Quiz Bomb challenges with friends. Compete in real-time rounds with shrinking timers, track scores, and earn points across a points system that rewards top finishers.

apps.name: GameBot
apps.description: The official demo bot for the Telegram Gaming Platform. Maintained by Telegram, it showcases the HTML5 games developers can publish through the Bot API, with sample leaderboards and scoring.

apps.name: Notcoin
apps.shortDescription: The original tap-to-earn game on Telegram
apps.description: The original tap-to-earn game on Telegram. Players tapped a gold coin to mine Notcoin during a months-long mining phase, then claimed the NOT token on TON after it listed on major exchanges. Credited with kicking off the wave of clicker mini apps in 2024.

apps.name: Blum
apps.description: A hybrid crypto exchange and play-to-earn app inside Telegram. Players farm Blum Points through daily check-ins, a falling-flowers mini game, and friend referrals, while also using Blum as a swap interface for tokens on Solana, TON, and other chains. Founded by former Binance executives.

apps.name: Major
apps.shortDescription: Star-tapping game with a full mini app
apps.description: A simple star tapping game on Telegram that grew into a full mini app with daily tasks, NFT trading, staking, and a built-in marketplace. Players collect Stars by completing missions, inviting friends, and holding the MAJOR token.

apps.name: Catizen
apps.shortDescription: Merge-style cat raising game on TON
apps.description: A merge style cat raising game built as a Telegram mini app. Players combine cats to evolve them into rarer breeds, earn vKitty points, and participate in seasonal events. Runs on TON.

apps.name: Gamee
apps.description: One of the oldest gaming hubs on Telegram, predating the mini app boom. Gamee hosts dozens of arcade style games inside Telegram, runs tournaments with prize pools, and distributes airdrops to active players.

apps.name: Bums
apps.description: A tap-to-earn mini app on TON with a cheeky brand and a strong focus on community memes. Players tap a character to earn Bums coins, complete daily missions, and invite friends for boosted multipliers.

apps.name: PlayDeck
apps.description: An HTML5 game launcher inside Telegram that lets you play multiplayer arcade and casual games with friends in any chat. Drop a game card into a group, tap to launch, and compete on shared leaderboards.

apps.name: Portals Market
apps.description: Decentralized marketplace inside Telegram for trading TON-based NFTs and collectible gifts. Open mystery portal boxes, list items for sale, and connect a TON wallet to buy and sell in seconds.

apps.name: MRKT
apps.description: TON-based NFT marketplace mini app for trading Telegram gifts, stickers, and collectibles. Supports auctions, multi-item listings, rarity filters, and direct TON wallet integration.

apps.name: Getgems
apps.shortDescription: The largest NFT marketplace on TON
apps.description: The largest NFT marketplace on The Open Network. Getgems hosts collections of Telegram usernames, anonymous numbers, gifts, domains, and original art, with auctions, trait-based filtering, and a built-in launchpad.

apps.name: Donate
apps.shortDescription: Receive donations from your Telegram audience
apps.description: The official Telegram bot that helps content creators receive financial support from their followers directly inside the app. Channel owners can collect donations, supporters can contribute without leaving Telegram.

apps.name: Tribute
apps.description: Monetization platform for Telegram creators. Tribute lets channel owners and group admins accept paid subscriptions, one-time donations, and digital product sales directly from members, with payouts handled inside the app.

apps.name: WantToPay
apps.description: Virtual Visa and Mastercard cards issued inside Telegram for paying international services like ChatGPT, Steam, Figma, and Netflix. Top up with crypto (USDT, TON, BTC) or fiat, add cards to Apple Pay and Google Pay.

apps.name: Telegraph
apps.description: The official companion bot for Telegra.ph, Telegram's anonymous publishing platform. Claim ownership of your articles, manage drafts across devices, edit posts after publishing, and check page view statistics.

apps.name: Skeddy
apps.description: A natural language reminder bot for Telegram. Type a sentence like 'remind me to call mom tomorrow at 7pm' and Skeddy schedules the alert in plain English, with recurring reminders and time zones.

apps.name: GitHub
apps.description: Get notifications about activity in your public GitHub repositories and post comments directly from Telegram. Pushes commit, issue, pull request, and release events into any connected chat.

apps.name: Trello
apps.description: Connect your Trello boards to Telegram and manage cards without switching apps. Receive notifications when cards are updated, create new cards by replying to messages, and get due-date reminders.

apps.name: IFTTT
apps.description: Link your Telegram groups and channels to more than 360 other services through IFTTT applets. Trigger messages from RSS feeds, weather alerts, smart home events, calendar updates, and more.

apps.name: Gmail Bot
apps.description: Connect a Gmail account to Telegram. Receive new emails as instant messages, compose new emails and replies directly from the chat, and delete or mark as spam without leaving Telegram.

apps.name: VoteBot
apps.description: The official Telegram polling bot. Create polls with custom questions and answer options, share them in any chat, and watch live results update as friends vote.

apps.name: Discussion Bot
apps.shortDescription: Link a discussion group to your channel
apps.description: The official bot for linking a discussion group to a Telegram channel so subscribers can leave comments on posts. Attach the bot, choose a group, and a Comment button appears under every channel post.

apps.name: LikeBot
apps.description: The official Telegram bot for creating posts with custom emoji-based like buttons. Compose a message, attach a row of reaction buttons, and share it to any chat where others can tap to react.

apps.name: TON Dating
apps.shortDescription: Selective dating mini app on TON
apps.description: Selective dating mini app on TON. Profiles are verified, active users earn TON rewards. Free for women; men pay a one-month subscription in Stars to access the app.

apps.name: Rose
apps.description: A powerful group management bot used by over two million Telegram communities. Provides anti-spam filters, custom welcome messages, warning systems, federated bans, note storage, and a flexible rules engine.

apps.name: Combot
apps.description: Moderation, analytics, and anti-spam suite for Telegram groups and channels, running since 2016. Offers chat statistics, automated CAPTCHA, language filters, scheduled posts, and reputation tracking.

apps.name: GroupHelp
apps.description: A full featured Telegram group management bot with anti-spam protection, welcome messages, scheduled posts, anti-flood controls, and word filters. Serves more than one million communities.

apps.name: Channel Help
apps.description: Comprehensive channel management bot. Schedule posts, add inline buttons and premium emoji, set welcome messages, run recurring posts, filter joins, and more. Popular with 2M+ monthly users.

apps.name: No Chinese Bot
apps.description: Group moderation bot that automatically removes messages containing Chinese characters and bans the sender. Add the bot to a group as admin and it works immediately, no setup required.

apps.name: Quiz Bot
apps.description: The official Telegram bot for building multi-question quizzes with multiple-choice answers. Create quizzes, share them in groups or channels, and challenge friends with timed scoring and live leaderboards.

apps.name: Wikipedia Search
apps.description: Telegram's official inline Wikipedia search bot. Type @wiki in any chat followed by a query to find and share Wikipedia articles instantly without opening a browser.

apps.name: GIF
apps.description: The official inline GIF search bot built into Telegram, powered by the Tenor library. Type @gif followed by a keyword in any chat to browse and send animated GIFs without leaving the conversation.

apps.name: IMDb
apps.description: Telegram's official inline IMDb bot. Works in any chat, no need to add it anywhere. Type @imdb followed by a movie or show name to share rich previews with ratings and details.

apps.name: Video Search
apps.description: Telegram's official inline video search bot. Same service as @youtube under a shorter username. Type @vid in any chat followed by a query to find and share videos.

apps.name: BotFather
apps.description: The one bot to rule them all. BotFather is the official Telegram bot used by developers to create new bots, generate API tokens, set commands, configure inline mode, and manage every bot they own.

apps.name: Stickers
apps.description: The official Telegram bot for creating and managing custom sticker packs. Upload images, assign emoji, build animated and video stickers, and publish packs for anyone on Telegram to add.

apps.name: Premium Bot
apps.description: The official bot for subscribing to Telegram Premium or gifting subscriptions to friends, with discounts up to 40 percent on multi-month plans.

apps.name: Spam Info Bot
apps.description: The official Telegram Spam Info Bot. If your account has been limited from messaging strangers or joining new groups, this bot explains why and lets you appeal the restriction.

apps.name: EU Regulation Bot
apps.shortDescription: GDPR / DSA requests for EU users
apps.description: Telegram's official EU Regulation Bot. The canonical route for users in the European Union to submit privacy and data protection requests under the Digital Services Act and GDPR.

apps.name: Press Bot
apps.description: The official bot of the Telegram Press Team. Journalists and media organizations use this bot to submit press requests, schedule interviews, and contact the Telegram team for comment.

apps.name: Username Bot
apps.description: The official Telegram bot for claiming an occupied username. If you own the same username on another platform and the matching Telegram handle is held by an inactive account, submit a claim here.

apps.name: Dr.Web
apps.description: Free antivirus bot from Dr.Web. Send a file or a link and the bot scans it for viruses and reports back. Works in private chats and in groups, with a quiet mode that only warns on threats.

apps.name: Designers Bot
apps.shortDescription: Submit UI ideas to improve Telegram
apps.description: Accepts UI layouts and animations intended to improve Telegram. Best contributions get published in @designers, Telegram's official channel for community design submissions.

apps.name: Telegram Jobs Bot
apps.description: Lists career opportunities at Telegram and accepts candidate applications. The official entry point for Telegram hiring, mirroring the openings at telegram.org/jobs.

apps.name: Verify Bot
apps.description: Telegram's official verification bot. Use it to start the verification process for a Telegram channel, public group, or bot that meets Telegram's verification criteria.

apps.name: Contest Bot
apps.description: The official entry point for Telegram's developer and content creator contests. See @contest for details on current and upcoming Telegram contests, prizes, and rules.

apps.name: Image Search
apps.description: Telegram's official inline image search bot powered by Yandex. Type @pic in any chat followed by a search query to find and share images directly in the conversation.

apps.name: MTProxy Admin Bot
apps.description: Telegram's official tool for setting up and managing MTProxy servers. Generate proxy configurations, sponsor channels through your proxy, and view connection statistics.

apps.name: TonMobile
apps.description: Buy eSIMs and mobile data plans with TON cryptocurrency, anywhere in the world. Pay in TON, USDT, or other crypto, activate via QR, and get connectivity without a bank or postal address.

apps.name: AnySticker
apps.description: Download and convert any Telegram sticker, custom emoji, or sticker pack into open formats: TGS, JSON, Lottie, PNG, GIF, WebP, and WebM, bundled into a single ZIP. Free, instant, no account needed.

apps.name: Image To Text
apps.description: Extract text from any image or PDF in seconds inside Telegram. Send a photo, screenshot, or document and get clean, copyable text back, with support for English, Hindi, Bengali, Arabic, Chinese, Spanish, and more.

apps.name: Fragment
apps.description: The official marketplace for collectible Telegram usernames, anonymous numbers, and gifts, settled entirely in TON. Every purchase is minted as an NFT on TON, tradable on Getgems and other secondary marketplaces.
